simple.meaning: מוּסָדָה (mûwçâdâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a foundation ; figuratively, an appointment.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Isaiah 30:32. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוּסָדָה (H4145) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מוּסָדָה (mûwçâdâh) / H4145 is traced through Isaiah 30:32, Ezekiel 41:8 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which Yahweh will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.

timeline.evidenceText: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which Yahweh will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.
I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.

definitions.full: H4145. musadah מוּסָדָה noun feminine foundation, appointment , מוּסָדָה מַטֵּה Isa 30:32 rod of appointment (compare Hab 1:12 יָסַד ), appointed rod (of punishment); plural construct מוּסְדוֺת Ezek 41:8 Qr, must mean foundations (si vera 1.); Kt perhaps intends Pu`al Participle מְיסָֻּדוֺת founded, and furnished with foundation (conjectural emendation by Co).
